items.title: CVE-2026-114062 - SvelteKit before 3.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that...
items.body: SvelteKit before 3.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to reach internal services because self-fetch fallbacks follow HTTP redirects automatically. Attackers can manipulate the Host or forwarded headers to point fallback requests at their server, which redirects them to internal services.

An attacker who can influence that untrusted value at prerender time can break out of the content attribute and inject HTML or JavaScript that executes when users visit the page.

items.body: SvelteKit (@sveltejs/kit) before 3.0.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in enhanced form actions (use:enhance) on routes accepting paths beginning with a double slash. Attackers can craft action paths starting with // that become protocol-relative URLs, causing non-redirect form results to navigate victims to attacker-controlled sites.

items.title: CVE-2026-114059 - ArcadeDB before 26.10.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allo...
items.body: ArcadeDB before 26.10.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated users, including read-only reader role holders, to execute Groovy code because GremlinQueryEngine.command() lacks scripting authorization checks. Attackers can submit Gremlin commands to the POST /api/v1/command/{database} endpoint when the Groovy engine is enabled to run OS commands as the server process user.

items.title: CVE-2026-114058 - ArcadeDB from 26.2.1 before 26.10.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerabili...
items.body: ArcadeDB from 26.2.1 before 26.10.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Bolt protocol handler that lets authenticated users read other databases' schema metadata. Attackers with credentials for one database can set the db field in RUN or BEGIN messages and call db.labels() or SHOW INDEXES to enumerate unauthorized schemas.

items.title: CVE-2026-114057 - ArcadeDB from 26.2.1 before 26.10.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerabili...
items.body: ArcadeDB from 26.2.1 before 26.10.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Bolt protocol handler that allows authenticated users to enumerate all database names. Attackers with credentials for any single database can issue a SHOW DATABASES query over the Bolt port to reveal unauthorized database names, exposing tenant or project identifiers.

items.title: CVE-2026-114056 - ArcadeDB from 26.8.1 before 26.10.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerabili...
items.body: ArcadeDB from 26.8.1 before 26.10.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows read-only users to modify edge type lightweight and unique schema flags without UPDATE_SCHEMA permission. Attackers can send a bare ALTER TYPE edgeType WITH lightweight = true command over the HTTP, gRPC, or Bolt command API to persistently alter edge storage declarations.

items.title: CVE-2026-114055 - vLLM from 0.7.3 before 0.31.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vuln...
items.body: vLLM from 0.7.3 before 0.31.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows remote clients to control multimodal processor parameters by supplying per-request mm_processor_kwargs. Attackers can set large image size, patch count, crop count, or frame count values in Isaac, InternVL, H2OVL, and other processors to exhaust memory and terminate the shared server.

items.title: CVE-2026-114054 - vLLM before 0.31.0 contains a cache aliasing vulnerability that allows authentic...
items.body: vLLM before 0.31.0 contains a cache aliasing vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to collide shared cache keys by supplying caller-controlled values such as EXIF ImageID or cache_salt. Attackers can set a UUID EXIF ImageID to receive another request's cached processed media, or match cache_salt to a LoRA name to reuse first-block KV state.

items.title: CVE-2026-114053 - vLLM from 0.7.3 before 0.31.0 forwards the request-supplied mm_processor_kwargs....
items.body: vLLM from 0.7.3 before 0.31.0 forwards the request-supplied mm_processor_kwargs.code_revision to Transformers AutoProcessor.from_pretrained, letting clients select which revision of a model's dynamic processor code is imported when trust_remote_code is enabled. An attacker controlling a revision in the served model repository can send a multimodal request to the unauthenticated /tokenize endpoint to execute arbitrary Python in the vLLM API process.

items.title: CVE-2026-114052 - vLLM after 0.24.0 and before 0.31.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability i...
items.body: vLLM after 0.24.0 and before 0.31.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in MOSS-Audio model serving that caches a processor for every distinct request-controlled mm_processor_kwargs value in an unbounded dictionary. Unauthenticated attackers can send distinct or oversized mel_config values to the /tokenize endpoint, which bypasses --api-key, to exhaust host memory and crash the API process.

items.title: CVE-2026-114051 - vLLM before 0.31.0 skips the min_tokens <= max_tokens check for /inference/v1/ge...
items.body: vLLM before 0.31.0 skips the min_tokens <= max_tokens check for /inference/v1/generate requests with a null max_tokens, so the EngineCore input thread later dies on an uncaught VLLMValidationError while /health still returns 200. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send one request with an oversized min_tokens to hang all subsequent generation requests until manual restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-114050 - vLLM before 0.31.0 uses a client-supplied multimodal uuid verbatim as cache iden...
items.body: vLLM before 0.31.0 uses a client-supplied multimodal uuid verbatim as cache identity with no consistency check on cache hits, allowing engine crashes. Unauthenticated attackers can desynchronize the P0/P1 processor caches to trigger a fatal token-placeholder mismatch, killing the entire serving instance until restarted.

items.title: CVE-2026-114049 - vLLM before 0.31.0 contains a cross-request mask leak in InputBatch.condense() t...
items.body: vLLM before 0.31.0 contains a cross-request mask leak in InputBatch.condense() that allows remote attackers to constrain other clients' outputs by leaving stale allowed_token_ids rows. Attackers can submit concurrent constrained generate requests, including via unauthenticated /invocations, so recycled batch slots apply their token allowlist to victims' unrestricted requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-114048 - WWBN AVideo before 24.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in l...
items.body: WWBN AVideo before 24.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in legacy endpoints like playlistStatus.php that bypass the .json.php-only autoCSRFGuard() check. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a page with an auto-submitting form to make private playlists public, remove playlist videos, or forge video suggestions.

items.title: CVE-2026-114047 - FreeRDP from 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an improper certificate validation vul...

items.title: CVE-2026-112202 - Imager::File::GIF versions before 1.006 for Perl allow out-of-bounds reads when ...
items.body:
Imager::File::GIF versions before 1.006 for Perl allow out-of-bounds reads when consolidating GIF images.

With `gif_consolidate => 1`, palette indices from the image are used without checking the colour table's bounds. The i_readgif_low routine reads beyond the heap allocation and copies the bytes into output pixels. The default GIF reader is not affected.

The same code ships bundled in the Imager distribution.

An attacker supplying a crafted GIF can disclose adjacent heap memory through the decoded output and may crash the process.

items.body: Argo CD is a declarative, GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes. From 2.1.0 until 3.3.15, 3.4.10, 3.5.4, and 3.6.0-rc2, when an operator has enabled --enable-helm for kustomize build, helmGlobals.configHome can point Helm's config and data directories at a repository-controlled location. items.title: CVE-2026-111756 - follow-redirects is a Node.js HTTP and HTTPS client wrapper that automatically f...
items.body: follow-redirects is a Node.js HTTP and HTTPS client wrapper that automatically follows redirects. From version 1.16.0 to before version 1.16.1, follow-redirects removes sensitive credential headers (Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie, and any caller-declared sensitiveHeaders) before following a redirect that crosses to a different host or downgrades to a less secure protocol. The removal routine iterates the caller's headers container with for...in and matches header names against a filter. This assumes the headers container is a plain object keyed by header names. Node's underlying http.request, which follow-redirects is a drop-in replacement for, also accepts headers as an alternating array of names and values. For an array, for...in yields the numeric indices "0", "1", "2" and so on, which never match a header-name filter, so nothing is removed. An application that sends array-form headers and follows an attacker-controlled cross-origin redirect therefore forwards its Authorization, Cookie, and Proxy-Authorization headers verbatim to the attacker-controlled destination, with no error or warning. The sensitiveHeaders option added to fix CVE-2026-40895 / GHSA-r4q5-vmmm-2653 is equally ineffective, because it relies on the same helper. This is an unauthenticated confidentiality vulnerability: any remote server the victim application contacts can harvest the victim's credential headers by responding with a cross-origin redirect. This issue has been patched in version 1.16.1.

A VideoStreaming interface reports the size of its whole class-specific descriptor block in the `wTotalLength` field of its input header. The USBX host recorded that figure and used it as the budget for walking the format, frame and frame-interval descriptors, without holding it against the configuration descriptor actually received.



A device that reports a `wTotalLength` larger than the descriptors it supplies therefore had its own claim believed. Once the real bytes ran out the walk kept going, dereferencing the cursor past the end of the configuration buffer, in the host's context, whenever the application queried format or frame data.

items.body: In Eclipse ioFog Controller versions 3.8.0 through 3.9.1, operator WebSocket upgrades on the exec and log routes do not verify the bearer JWT. items.title: CVE-2026-92287 - Pass-through of unvalidated KMS URLs to KMS clients in Apache C++ Parquet and Py...
items.body:
Pass-through of unvalidated KMS URLs to KMS clients in Apache C++ Parquet and PyArrow versions 4.0.0 to 25.0.1.




This affects users who read Parquet files and configure Parquet decryption properties with a KmsClient implementation.




On the reader side, the KMS URL can be application-controlled (specified in the KmsConnectionConfig) or file-controlled.
If the user does not leverage application control for this parameter, a file-controlled KMS URL is forwarded to a pluggable KmsClient implementation. 
If the KMS implementation does not perform host validation and makes use of the provided KMS URL, a KMS token can be sent to a malicious host set by an attacker in the file. 




Users are recommended to upgrade to version 26.0.0, which disables this behavior by default and requires that users opt-in to it by enabling the read_kms_url flag in the DecryptionConfiguration. Users of affected versions are recommended to either specify the KMS URL in the KmsConnectionConfig when reading files, or ensure any KmsClient implementations validate received KMS URLs. Users that opt-in to file-controlled KMS URLs in version 26.0.0 and later must ensure KmsClients validate KMS URLs.

items.title: CVE-2026-110725 - fast-uri is a dependency-free RFC 3986 URI parser and serializer for Node.js. In...
items.body: fast-uri is a dependency-free RFC 3986 URI parser and serializer for Node.js. In versions before 2.4.8, from 3.0.0 through 3.1.8, and from 4.0.0 through 4.2.2, when serialize(), normalize(), or resolve() are called with the non-default option reference set to suffix on a reference that has no authority, the emitted relative reference can contain a bare colon in its first path segment without escaping it, even though RFC 3986 forbids that because it makes the string reparse as an absolute URI with a scheme. An application that serializes or normalizes a relative reference with the suffix option and then treats the result as a URI can turn inert input into a live javascript, data, or vbscript URL, a cross-site scripting vector, and the equal() comparison can conflate a scheme-bearing reference with a relative one. Exposure is limited to applications using the non-default suffix reference option. The issue is fixed in fast-uri 2.4.8, 3.1.9, and 4.2.3, and users should upgrade to one of these versions or later. As a workaround, avoid the suffix reference option on untrusted input, or percent-encode a colon in the first path segment of the result before treating it as a URI.

items.title: CVE-2026-110306 - fast-uri is a dependency-free RFC 3986 URI parser and serializer for Node.js. In...
items.body: fast-uri is a dependency-free RFC 3986 URI parser and serializer for Node.js. In versions before 2.4.8, from 3.0.0 through 3.1.8, and from 4.0.0 through 4.2.2, fast-uri percent-decodes the scheme component with the legacy global unescape() function before validating it, so an input whose decoded scheme is a dangerous token is emitted as a live scheme even though RFC 3986 does not allow percent-encoding in a scheme and no other parser accepts it. An application that screens dangerous schemes on the raw input and then stores or renders the normalized or resolved result can turn an inert string into an executable javascript, data, or vbscript URL, producing a stored or reflected cross-site scripting vector, and the equal() comparison treats an encoded and a plain scheme as the same, which can bypass equality-based allowlists. The issue is fixed in fast-uri 2.4.8, 3.1.9, and 4.2.3, and users should upgrade to one of these versions or later. As a workaround, reject input whose scheme part contains a percent sign, or check the parsed scheme against an allowlist after normalization and use that same parsed result rather than the raw string.

items.title: CVE-2026-110180 - fast-uri is a dependency-free RFC 3986 URI parser and serializer for Node.js. In...
items.body: fast-uri is a dependency-free RFC 3986 URI parser and serializer for Node.js. In versions from 2.4.2 through 2.4.7, from 3.1.3 through 3.1.8, and from 4.0.1 through 4.2.2, for HTTP-family schemes the canonicalizeHost() function passes the parsed host to the WHATWG URL parser and adopts its hostname without checking that the parser consumed the entire input as a host, so the authority can be silently rewritten: data before an at-sign is dropped and tab, carriage-return, and line-feed characters are stripped, with no error reported. An application that enforces host-based policy such as denylists, loopback filtering, redirect validation, or outbound proxy routing on one representation can then see the canonical host diverge from what it checked, allowing traffic to be steered to an unintended destination. The issue is fixed in fast-uri 2.4.8, 3.1.9, and 4.2.3, and users should upgrade to one of these versions or later. As a workaround, reject an authority that contains more than one at-sign or any tab, carriage-return, or line-feed before calling fast-uri, or treat any non-empty parse error as fatal and compare hosts only from the same parse result.

items.title: CVE-2026-110095 - fast-uri is a dependency-free RFC 3986 URI parser and serializer for Node.js. In...
items.body: fast-uri is a dependency-free RFC 3986 URI parser and serializer for Node.js. In versions before 2.4.8, from 3.0.0 through 3.1.8, and from 4.0.0 through 4.2.2, the normalize() and serialize() functions apply RFC 3986 dot-segment removal to the path of a relative-path reference, even though that algorithm is defined only for the merged target path during resolution, so a leading parent-directory segment can be dropped and a document-relative reference can become root-relative. An application that normalizes an attacker-supplied or user-supplied relative reference and then resolves it, or uses it as a cache, deduplication, or authorization key, can have the reference escape its intended directory and point at a different resource. The issue is fixed in fast-uri 2.4.8, 3.1.9, and 4.2.3, and users should upgrade to one of these versions or later. As a workaround, resolve a relative reference against its absolute base first and normalize the absolute result instead of normalizing the reference beforehand.

items.title: FreeBSDにおける通信チャネルの不適切な宛名の指定に関する脆弱性
items.body: 未接続ソケットのIPv6 UDP送信経路は、ループバック宛先アドレスをjailのプライマリIPv6アドレスに書き換えるjailポリシーを適用していませんでした。そのため、クラシック（非VNET）jail内のプロセスは、ホストのIPv6ループバックアドレスで待機しているサービスにUDPデータグラムを送信でき、jailのネットワーク分離が回避される可能性があります。

items.title: FreeBSDにおける削除された特権に対する不適切なチェックに関する脆弱性
items.body: fdescfs(4) が "nodup" オプション付きでジュール内にマウントされている場合、/dev/fd/N を開くと、FD_RESOLVE_BENEATH やディスクリプター N の Capsicum ケイパビリティ権限が継承されていないディスクリプターが返されます。別のジュールからディレクトリファイルディスクリプターを受け取ったジュール内のプロセスは、これらの手法を利用してジュールのファイルシステムルート制限を回避できます。

items.title: FreeBSDにおける削除された特権に対する不適切なチェックに関する脆弱性
items.body: renameat(2) は、そのディレクトリ引数に対して FD_RESOLVE_BENEATH を適用していませんでした。これにより、監獄（jail）内のプロセスが制限されたディスクリプタに相対的なディレクトリ名の変更を行い、fchdir(2) を使って監獄のルートを脱出できる可能性がありました。この操作は、ディレクトリが監獄のルートからもアクセス可能なファイルシステム上に存在している必要があります。別の監獄からディレクトリのファイルディスクリプタを受け取った監獄内のプロセスは、これらの手法を用いて監獄のファイルシステムルートの制限を回避できます。

items.body: PCMサンプル配列を拡張する必要がある場合、RACKスタックは16ビットの割り当てカウンターを倍増させます。繰り返し倍増するとカウンターがゼロに巻き戻り、ほぼゼロ長の割り当てが発生し、その後既存のサンプルが過小サイズのバッファにコピーされてしまいます。リモートのピアは確立された接続上で十分な数のACKを送信することでこの拡張をトリガーできます。リモート攻撃者がRACKスタックを使用するシステムにTCP接続を確立できる場合、カーネルヒープに約512KBの境界外書き込みを引き起こし、カーネルパニックを誘発する可能性があります。
